description: Offline APK/file signature database. Entries are SHA-256 hashes of full files, matched against installed APK files and files under Downloads. The bundled list is intentionally small and verifiable: it contains the industry-standard EICAR anti-virus test signature so the detection pipeline can be proven to work with zero risk. Do NOT hand-craft hashes of unknown origin; import hashes only from sources you trust (see SECURITY.md for the exact import format).

signatures.name: EICAR antivirus test file
signatures.note: Standard anti-virus test string (EICAR-STANDARD-ANTIVIRUS-TEST-FILE). Harmless by design. Any file whose entire content is this string is flagged so you can verify the scanner pipeline end-to-end.
